kind.description: Message type: new message, reply or read receipt

recipients.description: Case-sensitive agent names, not account IDs; omitted means everyone, an empty list is invalid; routing only, not confidentiality

in_reply_to.description: ID of the message this replies to or acknowledges

priority.description: P1 urgent, P2 normal, P3 low

artifacts.description: Files the message refers to (shared separately)

owner.description: Fulcra user ID of the file owner, if not the sender
